title: Elaboration and synthesis of the whitlockite phase using limestone dust: in vitro bioactivity for biomedical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35281-35291

H. Agourrame, N. Khachani, A. Diouri, L. Rghioui, A. Zarrouk
Calcium silicate bioceramics are promising for biomedical use owing to Ca/Si being essential for bone health. Whitlockite, the second most abundant bone mineral after hydroxyapatite, shows excellent bioactivity for tissue engineering.
